name: Session-stateful inference provider for long-idle, long-context agents
one_line: A hosted open-model provider whose primitive is a durable warm agent session with KV tiered HBM -> RAM -> NVMe by measured break-evens and priced as residency + delta tokens; the restore physics is proven single-request to 16k in-engine, the differentiating idle-aware tiering policy is designed but unmeasured, and a single pre-registered benchmark (IGR-1) is built to settle conflicts #1-#6 in six weeks.

numeric_claims.claim: Median prefix per agent step 126,180 tokens (Claude Code) / 115,584 (Codex); median new input 857/886; median output 252/184
Human thinking gap median 1.4 min, p90 20.6 min; global prefix-cache hit 95.7% vs 84.4% on user-initiated steps

219 production Claude Code sessions: median 195K input / 317 output; 96% of requests reuse >=90% of input as verbatim prefix; inter-turn pauses median 2 s, p99 11.4 min; MLA KV 576 FP8 elements/token, TP=8 keeps eight KV copies
Codex traces: tool-driven inter-turn delays 5.2 s median / 81.4 s P99
99.9th-percentile Claude Code turn grew from under 25 min to over 45 min
Computer-use screenshots ~1,000-1,800 input tokens each; toolset definition ~4,500 tokens
Claude Code TTL regression: 17.1% overpayment ($949 Sonnet 4.6, $1,581 Opus 4.6) from 119,866 API calls
Codex on Azure: total cache misses past ~150K tokens; ~$15.9 for ~20M tokens; 3.28M re-billed tokens = 71% of fresh input
At step 10 of a typical agent loop ~11,500 input tokens processed to act on ~200 new tokens
Anthropic prompt cache: 5-min default TTL, 1h TTL at 2x base input write; cache read 0.1x; Sonnet 5 $2/$10 per MTok
Managed Agents session runtime $0.08 per session-hour, metered only while status is running
OpenAI: 30-min TTL for GPT-5.6+; pre-5.6 in_memory (5-10 min) or 24h retention with KV offloaded to GPU-local storage; prompt_cache_key does not pin to a machine
Gemini explicit cache storage $0.50-$4.50 per 1M tokens per hour; 1h default TTL; Interactions state retained 55 days on paid tier
DeepSeek disk cache cleared 'within a few hours to a few days'; cache hit ~3% of miss price (e.g. $0.014 vs $0.44 on V4-Flash)
Fireworks caching works only within 1 replica; ~50% cached discount; retention 'at least several minutes... up to several hours'
DeepInfra explicit 5m/1h retention at 1.25x/2x write, 0.2x read, 8,192-token increments; Llama 3.1 8B $0.02/$0.04, Llama 3.3 70B $0.10/$0.32 per 1M
Baseten cached input at 10% of input rate; BIS-LLM KV-aware routing over a real-time index of worker cache contents
Morph: automatic prefix caching with per-request TTL control, sticky placement via x-session-id, standby tier at 50%; Compact at 33,000 tok/s
Tensormesh: $24.5M total raised; cached input billed at $0; Operator 'coming soon'; post-v1 pricing 30% of estimated savings
LMCache eviction policies documented as LRU, IsolatedLRU, or noop; no TTL or idle-window eviction documented
Mooncake Store soft-pin TTL default 30 min, max 24 h; approximate LRU
llm-d P2P: 48K-token pull 235 ms vs 1,988 ms recompute on gpt-oss-120b
Continuum reports >8x average job-completion-time improvement; 'Stateful Inference' reports 2.1x and 4.2x per-turn speedups
vLLM 0.24 + LMCache CPU restore, Qwen2.5-7B, A100, single request: 4k 301->30 ms (10.0x), 16k 1,320->77 ms (17.1x); 16,384 tokens retrieved in 39.8 ms at 22.0 GB/s
HF pinned-CPU restore vs HF prefill, Qwen2.5-7B, A100: prefill 296/1,321/3,167/8,567 ms vs restore 25/115/182/297 ms at 4k/16k/32k/64k (11.8x-28.9x); NVMe naive torch.load 246/390/646/1,228 ms
vLLM prefill of Llama-3.1-8B/8k on A100 is 617 ms vs HFBackend 3.3-4.2 s (HF ~5-7x slower)
Cross-instance resume is bit-identical across two vLLM processes at TP=1; identical_output=true at 8k-64k in persist runs
fp8 and int8 KV at 0.5x bytes give 100% greedy agreement over 48 tokens (one passage)
Voice N=300 on L40S: VoiceKVConnector p95 316.8 ms stable vs LMCache 0.3.2 default 25,997.7 ms / layerwise 6,025.1 ms; ~2.5k-token sessions, seed 1
Voice arm D N=300 p95 272.2 ms PASS vs B 316.8 ms; 1.5x capacity; 8.1 ms margin on full-load window; whole-run p95 understates full-load p95 by 20-25 ms
Voice arm A collapsed when ~42 GB live KV exceeded a ~26 GB HBM KV pool (N=300, L40S)
Session service demo: 12k-token session 5.4 s cold -> 1.5 s warm (3.7x), one run

Dexa disk-backed connector: 0.37x at Llama-8B/8k (1,681 vs 617 ms); async load under 24x3072 p99 8,930 vs 5,596 ms and 16x8192 20,296 vs 9,379 ms (1.6-2.2x worse); effective tier bandwidths ~9-22 GB/s pinned RAM vs ~0.6-0.9 GB/s disk; voice aggregate ~1.5 GB/s at N=300

Cost model: 6.0x/4.9x/2.0x cheaper at 2/15/120 min idle (64k, 50 turns); break-evens at 64k HBM ~2 min, RAM ~11 min, NVMe ~4.9 hr; rates GPU $1.80/hr, RAM $0.006/GB-hr, NVMe $0.0002/GB-hr, 60 GB usable HBM; warm break-even = prefill_s x usable_HBM_GB / (kv_GB x 3600)
In-engine vLLM V1 runs crashed at >=32k across three configs; production curve confirmed only to 16k
Tiering policy is advisory only; sessions/tiering.py has no enforcement path; edge/README.md states the policy is advisory

VoiceKVConnector is 574 LOC; arm D protocol ~40 lines connector + 6-line client hint; dexa_platform/sessions 383 LOC; dexa_platform/control 620 LOC; gateway forces stream=False; SessionDO hard-codes max_tokens 16; warm = not first_touch
Dexa connector whole-prompt keying scored zero hits on vllm bench serve prefix_repetition (mean TTFT 3,355 ms vs 610 ms no-cache)
Every voice Modal manifest records git_sha 'unknown' and no kv_connector field
Llama-3.1-8B bf16 KV is 131 KB/token (8.4 GB at 64k; 16.8 GB at 128k derived); Qwen2.5-7B is 57,344 B/token (3.76 GB at 64k)

numeric_claims.claim: SGLang RFC #27574 proposes pin with bounded TTL and states orchestrators know session structure and tool-gap duration that request-local LRU cannot observe; Mooncake PR #2835 (TTL-bounded retention leases) is a draft
vLLM KVConnector V1 API is labeled 'experimental and subject to change'; vLLM OffloadingConnector ships LRU and ARC eviction with CPU primary and FS/S3/P2P secondary tiers
